dn29:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati. (Vedhaññā nāma Sakyā, tesaṃ ambavane pāsāde).
dn29:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nāthaputto Pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato hoti.
dn29:1.4: Tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā Nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā bhaṇḍana-jātā kalaha-jātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukha-sattīhi vitūdantā viharanti --
dn29:1.5: ‘Na tvaṃ imaṃ dhamma-vinayaṃ ājānāsi, ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi, kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhamma-vinayaṃ ājānissasi? -- Micchā-paṭipanno tvam asi, aham asmi sammā-paṭipanno, -- Sahitam me, asahitan te, -- Pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca, -Aviciṇṇan te viparāvattaṃ -- Āropito te vādo, niggahīto 'si -- Cara vādappamokkhāya, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosīti.'
dn29:1.6: Vadho yeva kho maññe Nigaṇṭhesu Nāthaputtiyesu vattati.
dn29:1.7: Ye pi Nigaṇṭhassa Nāthaputtassa sāvakā gihī odāta-vasanā, te pi Nigaṇṭhesu Nāthaputtiyesu nibbiṇṇarūpā viratta-rūpā paṭivāna-rūpā, yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammā-sambuddha -ppavedite bhinna-thūpe appaṭisaraṇe. 2.
dn29:2.1: Atha kho Cundo Samaṇuddeso Pāvāyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho, yena Sāmagāmo yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Cundo Samaṇuddeso āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
dn29:2.3: Tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā Nigaṇṭhā dvedhika-jātā . . . pe . . . bhinna-thūpe appaṭisaraṇe ti.'
dn29:2.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Cundaṃ Samaṇuddesaṃ etad avoca:
dn29:2.5: ‘Atthi kho idaṃ āvuso Cunda kathā-pābhataṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya,
dn29:2.6: āyām' āvuso Cunda, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamissāma, upasaṃkamitvā etam atthaṃ Bhagavato ārocessāmāti.'
dn29:2.7: ‘Evaṃ bhante ti' kho Cundo Samaṇuddeso āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi. 3.
dn29:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Ānando Cundo ca Samaṇuddeso yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu , upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca:
dn29:3.2: ‘Ayaṃ bhante Cundo Samaṇuddeso evam āha -- Nigaṇṭho Nāthaputto Pāvāyaṃ adhunā kālakato.
dn29:3.3: Tassa kālakiriyāya bhinnā Nigaṇṭhā dvedhika-jātā . . . pe . . . bhinna-thūpe appaṭisaraṇe ti.
dn29:4.1: ‘Evaṃ h' etaṃ Cunda hoti durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasama-saṃvattanike asammāsambuddha-ppavedite. 4.
dn29:4.2: Idha Cunda satthā ca hoti asammā-sambuddho; dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddha-ppavedito;
dn29:4.3: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhamma- paṭipanno viharati na sāmīci-paṭipanno na anudhamma-cāri, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattati.
dn29:4.5: ‘Tassa te āvuso lābhā, tassa te suladdhaṃ,
dn29:4.6: satthā ca te asammāsambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasama-saṃvattaniko asammāsambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:4.7: tvañ ca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharasi na sāmīci-paṭipanno na anudhammacārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattasīti.'
dn29:4.8: Iti kho Cunda satthā pi tattha gārayho, dhammo pi tattha gārayho, sāvako ca tattha evaṃ pāsaṃso.
dn29:4.9: Yo kho Cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya --
dn29:4.10: ‘Et' āyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññatto ti,'
dn29:4.11: yo ca samādapeti yañ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:4.13: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Cunda hoti durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasama-saṃvattanike asammāsambuddha-ppavedite. 5.
dn29:5.1: Idha pana Cunda satthā ca hoti asammā-sambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:5.2: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharati sāmīci-paṭipanno anudhamma-cārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattati.
dn29:5.4: ‘Tassa te āvuso alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, satthā ca te asammāsambuddho, dhammo ca durakkhāto duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasama-saṃvattaniko asammāsambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:5.5: tvañ ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhammapaṭipanno viharasi sāmīci-paṭipanno anudhamma-cārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattasīti.'
dn29:5.6: Iti kho Cunda satthā pi tattha gārayho, dhammo pi tattha gārayho, sāvako pi tattha evaṃ gārayho.
dn29:5.7: Yo kho Cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya --
dn29:5.9: yo ca pasaṃsati yañ ca pasaṃsati yo ca pasattho bhiyyoso-mattāya viriyaṃ ārabhati, sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:5.11: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Cunda hoti durakkhāte dhamma-vinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasama-saṃvattanike asammā-sambuddha ppavedite. 6.
dn29:6.1: Idha pana Cunda satthā ca hoti Sammā-Sambuddho dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:6.2: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharati na sāmīci-paṭipanno na anudhamma-cārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattati.
dn29:6.4: ‘Tassa te āvuso alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, satthā ca te SammāSambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:6.5: tvañ ca tasmiṃ dhamme na dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharasi na sāmīci-paṭipanno na anudhamma-cārī, vokkamma ca tamhā dhammā vattasīti.'
dn29:6.6: Iti kho Cunda satthā pi tattha pāsaṃso, dhammo pi tattha pāsaṃso, sāvako ca tattha evaṃ gārayho.
dn29:6.7: Yo kho Cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya --
dn29:6.8: ‘Et' āyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññatto ti,'
dn29:6.9: yo ca samādapeti yañ ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:6.11: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Cunda hoti svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasama-saṃvattanike SammāSambuddha-ppavedite. 7.
dn29:7.1: Idha pana Cunda satthā ca hoti Sammā-Sambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:7.2: sāvako ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharati sāmīci-paṭipanno anudhamma-cārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattati.
dn29:7.4: ‘Tassa te āvuso lābhā, tassa te suladdhaṃ,
dn29:7.5: satthā ca te arahaṃ Sammā- Sambuddho dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:7.6: tvañ ca tasmiṃ dhamme dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharasi, sāmīci-paṭipanno anudhamma-cārī, samādāya taṃ dhammaṃ vattasīti.'
dn29:7.7: Iti kho Cunda satthā pi tattha pāsaṃso, dhammo pi tattha pāsaṃso, sāvako pi tattha evaṃ pāsaṃso.
dn29:7.8: Yo kho Cunda evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya --
dn29:7.10: yo ca pasaṃsati yañ ca pasaṃsati, yo ca pasattho bhiyyosomattāya viriyaṃ ārabhati, sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
dn29:7.12: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Cunda hoti svākkhāte dhamma-vinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike SammāSambuddha-ppavedite. 8.
dn29:8.1: Idha pana Cunda satthā ca loke udapādi arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:8.2: aviññāpitatthā c' assa honti sāvakā saddhamme, na ca tesaṃ kevalaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttāni-kataṃ sabba-saṅgāha-pada-kataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:8.4: Evarūpo kho Cunda satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato anutappo hoti.
dn29:8.6: ‘Satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ SammāSambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito, aviññāpitatthā c' amha saddhamme, na ca no kevalaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttāni-kataṃ sabbasaṅgāha-pada-kataṃ sappāṭihīra-kataṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:8.8: Evarūpo kho Cunda satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato anutappo hoti. 9.
dn29:9.1: Idha pana Cunda satthā ca loke udapādi arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:9.2: viññāpitatthā c' assa honti sāvakā saddhamme, kevalañ ca tesaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttāni-kataṃ sabba-saṅgāha-pada-kataṃ sappāṭihīra-kataṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:9.4: Evarūpo kho Cunda satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato ananutappo hoti.
dn29:9.6: ‘Satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho,
dn29:9.7: dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:9.8: viññāpitatthā c' amha saddhamme, kevalañ ca no paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttāni-kataṃ sabba-saṅgāha-padakataṃ sappāṭihīra-kataṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ,
dn29:9.10: Evarūpo kho Cunda satthā sāvakānaṃ kālakato ananutappo hoti. 10.
dn29:10.1: Etehi ce pi Cunda aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, no ca kho satthā hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addha-gato vayo anuppatto,
dn29:10.2: evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ hoti ten' aṅgena.
dn29:10.3: Yato ca kho Cunda etehi c' eva aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cira-pabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto,
dn29:10.4: evan taṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ hoti ten' aṅgena. 11.
dn29:11.1: Etehi ce pi Cunda aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cira-pabbajito addha-gato vayo anuppatto, no ca kho assa therā bhikkhū sāvakā honti vyattā vinītā visāradā patta-yogakkhemā,
dn29:11.2: alaṃ samakkhātuṃ saddhammassa, alaṃ uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ;
dn29:11.3: evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ hoti ten' aṅgena. 12.
dn29:12.1: Yato ca kho Cunda etehi c' eva aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cira-pabbajito addha-gato vayo anuppatto, therā c' assa bhikkhū sāvakā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.6: no ca khv assa majjhimā bhikkhū sāvakā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.7: majjhimā 'ssa bhikkhū sāvakā honti . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa navā bhikkhū sāvakā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.8: navā c' assa bhikkhū sāvakā honti . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa therā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.9: therā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa majjhimā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.10: majjhimā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa navā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.11: navā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa upāsakā sāvakā honti gihī odāta-vasanā brahmacārino . . . pe . . . upāsakā c' assa sāvakā honti gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.12: no ca khv assa upāsakā sāvakā honti gihī odāta-vasanā kāma-bhogino . . . pe . . . upāsakā c' assa sāvakā honti gihī odāta-vasanā kāmabhogino . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.13: no ca khv assa upāsikā sāvikā honti gihiniyo odāta-vasanā brahmacāriniyo . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.14: upāsikā c' assa sāvikā honti gihiniyo odāta-vasanā brahmacāriniyo . . . pe . . . no ca khv assa upāsikā sāvikā honti gihiniyo odāta-vasanā kāma-bhoginiyo . . . pe . . . upāsikā c' assa sāvikā honti gihiniyo odāta-vasanā kāmabhoginiyo . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.15: no ca khv assa brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ c' eva hoti phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhu-jaññaṃ puthu-bhūtaṃ yāvad eva-manussehi suppakāsitaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn29:12.16: brahmacariyaṃ c' assa hoti iddhañ c' eva phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhu-jaññaṃ puthu-bhūtaṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ, no ca kho lābhagga-yasagga-ppattaṃ,
dn29:12.17: evan taṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ hoti ten' aṅgena . 13.
dn29:13.1: Yato ca kho Cunda etehi c' eva aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addha-gato vayo anuppatto, therā c' assa bhikkhū sāvakā honti vyattā vinītā . . . pe . . .
dn29:13.3: majjhimā c' assa bhikkhū sāvakā honti,
dn29:13.4: navā c' assa bhikkhū sāvakā honti,
dn29:13.5: therā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti,
dn29:13.6: majjhimā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti,
dn29:13.7: navā c' assa bhikkhuniyo sāvikā honti,
dn29:13.8: upāsakā c' assa sāvakā honti gihī odāta-vasanā brahmacārino,
dn29:13.9: upāsakā c' assa sāvakā honti gihī odāta-vasanā kāma-bhogino,
dn29:13.10: upāsikā c' assa sāvikā honti gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo,
dn29:13.11: upāsikā c' assa sāvikā honti gihiniyo odāta-vasanā kāma-bhoginiyo, brahmacariyaṃ c'
dn29:13.12: assa hoti iddhañ c' eva phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthu-bhūtaṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ lābhagga-yasagga-ppattañ ca,
dn29:13.13: evaṃ taṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ hoti ten' aṅgena. 14.
dn29:14.1: Ahaṃ kho pana Cunda etarahi satthā loke uppanno arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho,
dn29:14.2: dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasama-saṃvattaniko SammāSambuddha-ppavedito,
dn29:14.3: viññāpitatthā ca me sāvakā saddhamme, kevalañ ca tesaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ uttāni-kataṃ saṅgāha-pada-kataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
dn29:14.4: Ahaṃ kho pana Cunda etarahi satthā thero rattaññū cira-pabbajito addha-gato vayo anuppatto. 15.
dn29:15.1: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi therā bhikkhū sāvakā vyattā vinītā visāradā patta-yoga-kkhemā,
dn29:15.2: alaṃ samakkhātuṃ saddhammassa, alaṃ uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
dn29:15.3: Santi kho pana me Cunda majjhimā bhikkhū sāvakā vyattā.
dn29:15.4: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi navā bhikkhū sāvakā.
dn29:15.5: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi therā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā.
dn29:15.6: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi majjhimā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā.
dn29:15.7: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi navā bhikkhuniyo sāvikā.
dn29:15.8: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi upāsakā sāvakā gihī odāta-vasanā brahmacārino.
dn29:15.9: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi upāsakā sāvakā gihī odāta-vasanā kāmabhogino.
dn29:15.10: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi upāsikā sāvikā gihiniyo odāta-vasanā brahmacāriniyo.
dn29:15.11: Santi kho pana me Cunda etarahi upāsikā sāvikā gihiniyo odātavasanā kāma-bhoginiyo . . . pe . . .
dn29:15.12: etarahi kho pana me Cunda brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ ca phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhu-jaññaṃ puthu-bhūtaṃ yāvad eva manussehi suppakāsitaṃ. 16.
dn29:16.1: Yāvatā kho Cunda etarahi satthāro loke uppannā, nāhaṃ Cunda aññaṃ ekaṃ satthāram pi samanupassāmi evaṃ lābhagga-yasagga-ppattaṃ yatharivāhaṃ.
dn29:16.2: Yāvatā kho Cunda etarahi saṃghā vā gaṇā loke uppannā,
dn29:16.3: nāhaṃ Cunda aññaṃ ekaṃ saṃghaṃ pi samanupassāmi evaṃ lābhagga-yasagga-ppattaṃ yathariva Cunda bhikkhusaṅgho.
dn29:16.4: Yaṃ kho taṃ Cunda sammā-vadamāno vadeyya --
dn29:16.5: ‘Sabbākāra-sampannaṃ sabbākāra-paripūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevala-paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitan ti,'
dn29:16.8: Uddako sudaṃ Cunda Rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
dn29:16.11: Khurassa sādhu-nisitassa talam assa passati, dhārañ ca kho tassa na passati.
dn29:16.14: Taṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda -Uddakena Rāmaputtena bhāsitaṃ hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anattha-saṃhitaṃ khuram eva sandhāya.
dn29:16.15: Yañ ca taṃ Cunda sammā-vadamāno vadeyya --
dn29:16.16: ‘Passaṃ na passatīti,' idam eva taṃ sammā-vadamāno vadeyya --
dn29:16.19: Evaṃ sabbākāra-sampannaṃ sabbākāra-paripūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevala-paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitan ti. Iti h' etaṃ passati,
dn29:16.20: idam ettha apakaḍḍheyya, evan taṃ parisuddhataraṃ assāti. Iti h' etaṃ na passati,
dn29:16.21: idam ettha upakaḍḍheyya, evan taṃ paripūraṃ assāti. Iti h' etaṃ na passati,
dn29:16.24: Yaṃ kho taṃ Cunda sammāvadamāno vadeyya --
dn29:16.28: ‘Sabbākāra-sampannaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ anūnaṃ anadhikaṃ svākkhātaṃ kevala-paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ suppakāsitan ti.' 17.
dn29:17.1: Tasmāt iha Cunda ye vo mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, tattha sabbeh' eva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn29:17.2: Katame ca te Cunda mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā yattha sabbeh' eva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira-ṭṭhitikaṃ, tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ?
dn29:17.3: Seyyathīdaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro samma- ppadhānā, cattāro iddhi-pādā, pañc' indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko Maggo.
dn29:17.4: Ime kho te Cunda dhammā mayā abhiññā desitā,
dn29:17.5: yattha sabbeh' eva saṃgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa cira- ṭṭhitikaṃ , tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ. 18.
dn29:18.1: Tesañ ca vo Cunda samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, aññataro sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya.
dn29:18.3: ‘Ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthañ c' eva micchā gaṇhāti , vyañjanāni ca micchā ropetīti,'
dn29:18.4: tassa n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ. Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā so evam assa vacanīyo --
dn29:18.5: ‘Imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imāni vā vyañjanāni etāni vā vyañjanāni, katamāni opāyikatarāni; imesaṃ vā vyañjanānaṃ ayaṃ vā attho eso vā attho, katamo opāyikataro ti?'
dn29:18.7: ‘Imassa kho āvuso atthassa imān' eva vyañjanāni opāyikatarāni yāni c' eva etāni, imesaṃ vyañjanānaṃ ayam eva attho opāyikataro yo c' eva eso ti,'
dn29:18.8: so n' eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. Anussādetvā na apasādetvā so va sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo, tassa ca atthassa tesañ ca vyañjanānaṃ nisantiyā. 19.
dn29:19.1: Aparo pi ce Cunda sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya.
dn29:19.3: ‘Ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthaṃ hi kho micchā gaṇhāti, vyañjanāni sammā ropetīti,'
dn29:19.4: tassa n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ. Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā so evam assa vacanīyo --
dn29:19.5: ‘Imesaṃ nu kho āvuso vyañjanānaṃ ayaṃ vā attho eso vā attho, katamo opāyikataro ti?'
dn29:19.7: ‘Imesaṃ kho āvuso vyañjanānaṃ ayam eva attho opāyikataro, yo c' eva eso ti,'
dn29:19.8: so n' eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. Anussādetvā anapasādetvā so yeva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tass' ev' atthassa nisantiyā. 20.
dn29:20.1: Aparo pi ce Cunda sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya,
dn29:20.3: ‘Ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthaṃ hi kho sammā gaṇhāti, vyañjanāni micchā ropetīti,'
dn29:20.4: tassa n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ. Anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā so evam assa vacanīyo
dn29:20.5: -‘Imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imāni ca vyañjanāni etāni vā vyañjanāni, katamāni opāyikatarānīti?'
dn29:20.7: ‘Imassa nu kho āvuso atthassa imān' eva vyañjanāni opāyikatarāni, yāni c' eva etānīti,'
dn29:20.8: so n' eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo. Anussādetvā anapasādetvā so yeva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tesaṃ ñeva vyañjanānaṃ nisantiyā. 21.
dn29:21.1: Aparo pi ce Cunda sabrahmacārī saṅghe dhammaṃ bhāseyya,
dn29:21.3: ‘Ayaṃ kho āyasmā atthaṃ ñeva sammā gaṇhāti, vyañjanāni sammā ropetīti,'
dn29:21.5: Tassa ‘Sādhūti' bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā so evam assa vacanīyo --
dn29:21.7: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma evaṃ atthūpetaṃ vyañjanūpetan ti.' 22.
dn29:22.1: Navaṃ ahaṃ Cunda diṭṭha-dhammikānaṃ yeva āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya dhammaṃ desemi.
dn29:22.2: Na panāhaṃ Cunda samparāyikānaṃ yeva āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya dhammaṃ desemi,
dn29:22.3: diṭṭha-dhammikānaṃ c' evāhaṃ Cunda āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya dhammaṃ desemi
dn29:22.5: Tasmāt iha Cunda yaṃ vo mayā cīvaraṃ anuññātaṃ, alaṃ vo taṃ
dn29:22.6: yāvad eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vātātapasiriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvad eva hirikopīna-paṭicchādanatthaṃ.
dn29:22.7: Yo vo mayā piṇḍapāto anuññāto, alaṃ vo so
dn29:22.8: yāvad eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya -- ‘Iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi , yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.'
dn29:22.9: Yaṃ vo mayā senāsanaṃ anuññātaṃ, alaṃ vo taṃ
dn29:22.10: yāvad eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya daṃsa-makasa- vātātapa -siriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāvad eva utu-parissaya-vinodakaṃ paṭisallāṇārāmatthaṃ.
dn29:22.11: Yo vo mayā gilāna-paccaya -bhesajja-parikkhāro anuññāto, alaṃ vo so
dn29:22.12: yāvad eva uppannānaṃ veyyābādhikānaṃ vedanānaṃ paṭighātāya abyāpajjhaparamatāyāti. 23.
dn29:23.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati, yaṃ añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:23.3: Evaṃ vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:23.5: Sukhallikānuyogā pi hi bahū aneka-vihitā nāna-ppakārakā ti.'
dn29:23.6: Cattāro 'me Cunda sukhallikānuyogā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anattha-saṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:23.8: Idha Cunda ekacco bālo pāṇe vadhitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti,
dn29:23.10: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda idh' ekacco adinnaṃ ādiyitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti,
dn29:23.12: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda idh' ekacco musā-bhaṇitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti,
dn29:23.14: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda idh' ekacco pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappito samaṅgi-bhūto parivāreti,
dn29:23.16: Ime kho Cunda cattāro sukhallikānuyogā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anattha-saṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti. 24.
dn29:24.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati, yaṃ aññatitthiyā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ --
dn29:24.2: ‘Ime cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttā Samaṇā Sakya-puttiyā viharantīti?'
dn29:24.4: na vo te sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ, abbhācikkheyyuṃ vo te asatā abhūtena.
dn29:24.5: Cattāro 'me Cunda sukhallikānuyogā ekanta-nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:24.7: Idha Cunda bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.9: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ dutiya-jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn29:24.11: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā . . . pe . . .
dn29:24.13: Puna ca paraṃ Cunda bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā . . . pe . . .
dn29:24.15: Ime kho Cunda cattāro sukhallikānuyogā ekanta-nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
dn29:24.16: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:24.17: ‘Ime cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttā Samaṇā Sakya-puttiyā viharantīti.'
dn29:24.19: sammā vo te vadamānā vadeyyuṃ, na vo te abbhācikkheyyuṃ asatā abhūtena. 25.
dn29:25.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ añña titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:25.2: ‘Ime pana āvuso cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ kati phalāni kat' ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā ti?'
dn29:25.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā
dn29:25.4: -‘Ime kho āvuso cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ cattāri phalāni cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
dn29:25.6: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipāta-dhammo niyato sambodhi-parāyano.
dn29:25.8: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāga-dosa-mohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti.
dn29:25.10: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvatti-dhammo tasmā lokā.
dn29:25.12: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu āsavānam khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttim paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn29:25.14: Ime kho āvuso cattāro sukhallikānuyoge anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ imāni cattāri phalāni cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā ti.' 26.
dn29:26.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:26.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:26.4: ‘Atthi kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā SammāSambuddhena sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā paññattā yāva- jīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā.
dn29:26.5: Seyyathā pi āvuso inda-khīlo vā ayo-khīlo vā gambhīra-nemo sunikhāto acalo asampavedhī,
dn29:26.6: evam eva kho āvuso tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā Sammā-Sambuddhena sāvakānaṃ dhammā desitā paññattā yāva- jīvaṃ anatikkamanīyā.
dn29:26.7: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā kata-karaṇīyo ohita-bhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇa -bhava-saṃyojano sammad-aññā vimutto, abhabbo so nava ṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ.
dn29:26.8: Abhabbo āvuso khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ ādātuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajāna-musā bhāsituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhi-kārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ, seyyathā pi pubbe agāriya-bhūto. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu chandāgatiṃ gantuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu dosāgatiṃ gantuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu mohāgatiṃ gantuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu bhayāgatiṃ gantuṃ.
dn29:26.9: Yo so āvuso bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohita-bhāro anuppatta-sadattho parikkhīṇa-bhavasaṃyojano sammad-aññā vimutto, abhabbo so imāni nava ṭhānāni ajjhācaritun ti.' 27.
dn29:27.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:27.2: ‘Atītaṃ kho addhānaṃ ārabbha Samaṇo Gotamo atīrakaṃ ñāṇa-dassanaṃ paññāpeti, no ca kho anāgataṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha atīrakaṃ ñāṇa-dassanaṃ paññāpeti; tayidaṃ kiṃ su tayidaṃ kathaṃ sūti?'
dn29:27.3: Ten' eva añña-titthiyā paribbājakā añña-vihitakena ñāṇa-dassanena añña-vihitakaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ maññanti, yatheriva bālā avyattā.
dn29:27.4: Atītaṃ kho Cunda addhānaṃ ārabbha Tathāgatassa satānusāri-viññāṇaṃ hoti.
dn29:27.6: Anāgatañ ca kho addhānaṃ ārabbha Tathāgatassa bodhijaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati --
dn29:27.7: ‘Ayam antimā jāti, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo ti.' 28.
dn29:28.1: Atītañ ce pi Cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na taṃ Tathāgato vyākaroti. Atītaṃ
dn29:28.2: ce pi Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anattha-saṃhitaṃ, tam pi Tathāgato na vyākaroti. Atītaṃ ce pi Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ attha-saṃhitaṃ, tatra kālaññū hoti Tathāgato tassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya. Anāgataṃ ce pi Cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ
dn29:28.3: anattha-saṃhitaṃ, na taṃ Tathāgato vyākaroti. Anāgataṃ ce pi Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anattha-saṃhitaṃ, tam pi Tathāgato na vyākaroti. Anāgataṃ ce pi Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ tatra kālaññū hoti Tathāgato tassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya
dn29:28.4: saṃkhittaṃ. Paccuppannaṃ ce pi Cunda hoti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anattha-saṃhitaṃ, na taṃ Tathāgato vyākaroti. Paccuppannaṃ
dn29:28.6: Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anattha-saṃhitaṃ, tam pi Tathāgato na vyākaroti. Paccuppannaṃ
dn29:28.7: ce pi Cunda hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ, tatra kālaññū hoti Tathāgato tassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya.
dn29:28.8: Iti kho Cunda atītānāgata-paccuppannesu dhammesu Tathāgato kāla-vādī bhūta-vādī attha-vādī dhamma-vādī vinaya-vādī. Tasmā Tathāgato ti vuccati. 29.
dn29:29.1: Yaṃ kho Cunda sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, sabbaṃ Tathāgatena abhisambuddhaṃ.
dn29:29.3: Yañ ca Cunda rattiṃ Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammā-sambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañ ca rattim anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, yaṃ etasmiṃ antare bhāsati lapati niddisati, sabbaṃ taṃ tath' eva hoti no aññathā.
dn29:29.5: Yathā-vādī Cunda Tathāgato tathākārī, yathā-kārī tathā-vādī.
dn29:29.6: Iti yathā-vādī tathā-kārī, yathā-kārī tathā-vādī, tasmā Tathāgato ti vuccati.
dn29:29.7: Sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva-manussāya Tathāgato abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu-daso vasavattī. Tasmā Tathāgato ti vuccati. 30.
dn29:30.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:30.2: ‘Kin nu kho āvuso hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā? idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti?'
dn29:30.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:30.5: Hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.'
dn29:30.6: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati, yaṃ añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
dn29:30.7: -‘Kiṃ pan' āvuso na hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā? idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti?'
dn29:30.8: Evaṃ- vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:30.10: Na hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.'
dn29:30.11: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati, yaṃ añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:30.12: ‘Kin nu kho āvuso hoti ca na hoti ca Tathāgato param maraṇā . . .
dn29:30.17: pe . . . n' eva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti?'
dn29:30.18: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:30.20: N' eva hoti na na hoti Tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.' 31.
dn29:31.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:31.2: ‘Kasmā pan' etaṃ āvuso Samaṇena Gotamena avyākatan ti?'
dn29:31.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā
dn29:31.4: -‘Na h' etaṃ āvuso attha-saṃhitaṃ na dhamma-saṃhitaṃ na ādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati. Tasmā taṃ Bhagavatā avyākatan ti.' 32.
dn29:32.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:32.2: ‘Kiṃ pan' āvuso Samaṇena Gotamena vyākatan ti?'
dn29:32.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:32.4: ‘Idaṃ dukkhan ti kho āvuso Bhagavatā vyākataṃ, Ayaṃ dukkha-samudayo ti kho āvuso Bhagavatā vyākataṃ, Ayaṃ dukkha-nirodha ti kho āvuso Bhagavatā vyākataṃ, Ayaṃ dukkha-nirodhogāminī paṭipadā ti kho āvuso Bhagavatā vyākatan ti.' 33.
dn29:33.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ --
dn29:33.2: ‘Kasmā pan' etaṃ āvuso Samaṇena Gotamena vyākatan ti?'
dn29:33.3: Evaṃ-vādino Cunda añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā --
dn29:33.4: ‘Etaṃ hi āvuso attha-saṃhitaṃ, etaṃ dhamma-saṃhitaṃ, etaṃ ādi-brahmacariyakaṃ, ekanta-nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. Tasmā taṃ Bhagavatā vyākatan ti.' 34.
dn29:34.1: Ye pi te Cunda pubbanta-sahagatā diṭṭhi-nissayā, te pi vo mayā vyākatā yathā te vyākattabbā,
dn29:34.2: yathā ca kho te na vyākattabbā, kiṃ no ahaṃ tathā vyākarissāmi? Ye pi te Cunda aparanta-sahagatā diṭṭhi-nissayā, te pi vo mayā vyākatā yathā te vyākattabbā, yathā ca kho te na vyākattabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tathā vyākarissāmi?
dn29:34.5: Katame te Cunda pubbanta-sahagatā diṭṭhi-nissayā ye vo mayā vyākatā yathā te vyākattabbā
dn29:34.7: Santi Cunda eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:34.8: ‘Sassato attā ca loko ca, idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti.'
dn29:34.9: Santi pana Cunda eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:34.11: Sassato ca asassato ca attā ca loko ca . . .
dn29:34.12: pe . . . N' eva sassato nāsassato attā ca loko ca . . .
dn29:34.13: pe . . . Sayaṃ-kato attā ca loko ca . . .
dn29:34.14: pe . . . Paraṃ-kato attā ca loko ca . . .
dn29:34.15: pe . . . Sayaṃ-kato ca paraṃ-kato ca attā ca loko ca . . .
dn29:34.16: pe . . . Asayaṃ-kāro aparaṃ-kāro adhicca-samuppanno attā ca loko ca. Idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.'
dn29:34.20: N' eva sassataṃ nāsassataṃ sukha-dukkhaṃ: Sayaṃ-
dn29:34.24: aparaṃ-kāraṃ adhicca-samuppannaṃ sukha-dukkhaṃ. Idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti. 35.
dn29:35.1: Tatra Cunda ye te Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:35.2: ‘Sassato attā ca loko ca, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti,'
dn29:35.6: Yañ ca kho te evam āhaṃsu --
dn29:35.10: Aññathā-saññino pi h' ettha Cunda sant' eke sattā.
dn29:35.11: Imāya pi kho ahaṃ Cunda paññattiyā n' eva attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo,
dn29:35.12: atha kho aham eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhippaññatti. 36.
dn29:36.1: Tatra Cunda ye te Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:36.3: Sassato ca asassato ca attā ca loko ca:
dn29:36.4: N' eva sassato nāsassato attā ca loko ca:
dn29:36.7: Sayaṃ-kato ca paraṃ-kato ca attā ca loko ca:
dn29:36.8: Asayaṃ-kāro ca aparaṃ-kāro ca adhicca-samuppanno attā ca loko ca:
dn29:36.12: N' eva sassataṃ nāsassataṃ sukha-dukkhaṃ: Sayaṃ-
dn29:36.16: aparaṃ-kāraṃ adhicca-samuppannaṃ sukha-dukkhaṃ. Idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti: '
dn29:36.20: Yañ ca kho te evam āhaṃsu, --
dn29:36.24: Aññathā-saññino pi h' ettha Cunda sant' eke sattā.
dn29:36.25: Imāya pi kho ahaṃ Cunda paññattiyā n' eva attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo,
dn29:36.26: atha kho aham eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhippaññatti.
dn29:36.27: Ime kho te Cunda pubbantasahagatā diṭṭhi-nissayā, ye vo mayā vyākatā yathā te vyākattabbā,
dn29:36.28: yathā ca te na vyākattabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tattha vyākarissāmi? 37.
dn29:37.1: Katame ca te Cunda aparanta-sahagatā diṭṭhinissayā ye vo mayā vyākatā yathā te vyākattabbā
dn29:37.3: Santi Cunda eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃdiṭṭhino --
dn29:37.4: ‘Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.'
dn29:37.5: Santi pana Cunda eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:37.7: Rūpī ca arūpī ca attā hoti. . . .
dn29:37.8: N' eva rūpī nārūpī attā hoti. . . .
dn29:37.11: N' eva saññī nāsaññī attā hoti. . . .
dn29:37.12: Attā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti.' 38.
dn29:38.1: Tatra Cunda ye te Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:38.2: ‘Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti,'
dn29:38.5: ‘Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti?'
dn29:38.6: Yañ ca kho te evam āhaṃsu
dn29:38.10: Aññathā-saññino pi h' ettha Cunda sant' eke sattā.
dn29:38.11: Imāya pi kho ahaṃ Cunda paññattiyā n' eva attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo,
dn29:38.12: atha kho Cunda aham eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhippaññatti. 39.
dn29:39.1: Tatra Cunda ye te Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino --
dn29:39.3: Rūpī ca arūpī ca attā hoti. . . .
dn29:39.4: N' eva rūpī nārūpī attā hoti. . . .
dn29:39.7: N' eva saññī nāsaññī attā hoti. . . .
dn29:39.8: Attā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti: '
dn29:39.11: ‘Attā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti param maraṇā ti?'
dn29:39.12: Yañ ca kho te Cunda evam āhaṃsu --
dn29:39.16: Aññathā saññino pi h' ettha Cunda sant' eke sattā.
dn29:39.17: Imāya pi kho ahaṃ Cunda paññattiyā n' eva attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo,
dn29:39.18: atha kho aham eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhippaññatti.
dn29:39.19: Ime kho Cunda aparanta-sahagatā diṭṭhi-nissayā ye vo mayā vyākatā, yathā te vyākattabbā;
dn29:39.20: yathā ca te na vyākattabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tathā vyākarissāmi? 40.
dn29:40.1: Imesañ ca Cunda pubbanta-sahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesañ ca aparanta-sahagatānaṃ diṭṭhi -nissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā.
dn29:40.3: Idha Cunda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ,
dn29:40.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhā-domanassaṃ.
dn29:40.7: Imesañ ca Cunda pubbanta-sahagatānaṃ diṭṭhi-nissayānaṃ imesañ ca aparanta-sahagatānaṃ diṭṭhi-nissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evam mayā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā ti. 41.
dn29:41.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upavāno Bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti Bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
dn29:41.2: Atha kho āyasmā Upavāno Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn29:41.5: atipāsādiko vatāyaṃ bhante dhamma-pariyāyo. Ko nāmo ayaṃ bhante dhamma-pariyāyo ti?'
dn29:41.6: ‘Tasmāt iha tvaṃ Upavāna imaṃ dhamma-pariyāyaṃ "Pāsādiko" ti eva naṃ dhārehīti.'
dn29:41.8: Attamano āyasmā Upavāno Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
